_comment: Default tick rules for consent.html. Every tick box on a form is tested against these rules in order and the first match decides its default. 'match' tests the box's whole label; 'prompt', 'option' and 'section' test the question, the option text and the part of the form the box is in (e.g. 'Common side effects:'). tick: always | female | male | known (ticked once sex is chosen) | review (left blank, flagged for the clinician) | never (left blank, e.g. the patient's own confirmations). Boxes that match nothing are ticked when they are a statement or risk (5+ words), otherwise left for review. Every default can be changed on the page before the pack is built.
